title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Statement Glossary: Interest-Bearing Balance
content:
**Interest-bearing balance.** For a notice that a purchase processed in a foreign currency or outside the United States posted twice to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the interest-bearing balance is the latest statement balance less its promotional balance and less any disputed amount it excluded when the latest statement shows a promotional balance; the latest statement balance less the disputed amount it excluded when it shows no promotional balance but excluded a disputed amount; and otherwise the latest statement balance. A balance so reduced is rounded half up to the cent.

The figures are read from the latest statement (the account's most recent statement by statement date): its statement balance, its promotional balance and its disputed amount excluded.

## By case

| Latest statement shows a promotional balance | Latest statement excluded a disputed amount | Interest-bearing balance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the statement balance less the promotional balance and less any excluded disputed amount |
| no | yes | the statement balance less the excluded disputed amount |
| no | no | the statement balance |

## Examples (hypothetical latest statement with a balance of USD 2400.00)

- Promotional balance USD 800.00 and disputed amount excluded USD 150.00: USD 1450.00.
- Promotional balance USD 800.00, nothing excluded: USD 1600.00.
- No promotional balance, disputed amount excluded USD 150.00: USD 2250.00.
- Neither: USD 2400.00.
